<script>
  import { setCurrency } from './currency.js';
  import Header from './Header.svelte';
  import ProductList from './ProductList.svelte';
  import Cart from './Cart.svelte';
  import Modal from './Modal.svelte';
  import CheckoutForm from './CheckoutForm.svelte';

  let { products } = $props();

  setCurrency('USD');

  let checkoutOpen = $state(false);
</script>

<Header oncheckout={() => (checkoutOpen = true)} />
<main>
  <ProductList {products} />
  <Cart />
</main>

{#if checkoutOpen}
  <Modal title="Checkout" onclose={() => (checkoutOpen = false)}>
    <CheckoutForm onsubmitted={() => (checkoutOpen = false)} />
  </Modal>
{/if}

    {#each cart.items as item (item.id)}
  • {item.name} item.quantity, (v) => cart.setQuantity(item.id, v)} /> {formatMoney(item.price * item.quantity, currency)}
    • {/each}
{:else}

Your cart is empty

{/if}

<script>
  let { onsearch, delay = 300 } = $props();

  let query = $state('');
  let timer;

  function oninput() {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => onsearch(query), delay);
  }

  $effect(() => () => clearTimeout(timer));
</script>

<input type="search" placeholder="Search products" bind:value={query} {oninput} />
